key_features: 【Product Highlights】This 15-piece crevice cleaning kit includes hard bristle grout cleaning brush, putty knife scraper, straw brushes, bend brush, wire brushes and other handy brush—perfect for tackling every cleaning scenario. Plus, nearly every brush handle features a hanging hole at the end, making storage a breeze. Keep them organized, easy to grab.

【Design Advantages】The crevice cleaner brush heads are designed to fit the ergonomics, and the handles have a comfortable grip, facilitating force application and operation. Different brush heads are optimized for shape and bristle density. For example, the grout brush is slender for deep access, the straw brush fits the pipe diameter, the bend brush has full coverage, and the scraper easily removes stubborn stains. While cleaning efficiently, it reduces hand fatigue and makes cleaning easier.

【Superior Material Quality】Crevice cleaning brushes made of high - quality environmental - friendly plastic and durable bristle materials, it has strong toughness and is not easy to break. The bristles are not easy to fall off and deform and can be used repeatedly. Metal parts such as stainless - steel straw brushes are rust - proof and corrosion - resistant, ensuring the long - term durability of the tools and providing you with a long - lasting and reliable cleaning solution.

【Convenient Use】Multifunctional Cleaning Brush Tool is Lightweight and portable, it doesn't take up space for storage and can be used at any time. After cleaning, it can be directly rinsed with water and quickly drained to keep the tools clean and hygienic. Whether it's for daily household cleaning, or for traveling or renting a house, this set of tools is a practical good helper, making cleaning easy anytime and anywhere.

【Wide Application】The crevice cleaning brush set not only suitable for home kitchens, bathrooms, living rooms and other scenarios, but also can be used for cleaning the gaps of car interiors, office desktop keyboards, appliance crevices, tile grout, shower corners, the edges of kitchen sink and oven crevices etc. It meets the cleaning needs of multiple scenarios and is a practical good item to improve the cleanliness of living and working environments, bringing you a comprehensive cleaning experience.
